summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus — by lot the bride of Argius son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus allots Evippe to Argius among the sons of Egyptus who drew lots for Danaus' daughters borne on a Phoenician woman — one of the seven pairings named before the mass slaughter of the wedding night. Hyginus lists her among the brides who killed their husbands, naming Agenor as the man she slew.
